a.java: Row/column anchor node collected from marker pixels; unrelated static helpers retain their separate purposes.
ae.java: Socket-backed resource request sending, response headers, continuation blocks and XOR decoding.
ag.java: Diagnostic EventCombat; battle, combat, attack, damage and death records.
al.java: Spell-table dispatch for effects that do not carry target coordinates.
am.java: Decodes packed paths and signed target deltas; validates movement, attacks, vine growth and teleportation.
ar.java: Opcode-decoded text fragments, linked phrase IDs and command-definition argument rows; preview joins fragments with ellipses. Unrelated static helpers retain separate purposes.
as.java: EventSwitch diagnostic and Unit.b(newOwner,-1) in apply.
at.java: Sentinel node, prepend/append, pop and bidirectional traversal.
au.java: Lobby room record and client row: player capacity/options, owner, play/join/invitation state, notification lifetime and ordering. Unrelated static helpers retain separate purposes.
aw.java: Retains the highest-score candidate; equal scores retain the previous choice.
bb.java: Independent forward/reverse deque traversal, preserving a cursor while nodes unlink.
bc.java: Six-byte entry index and chained 520-byte sectors with small/large entry headers.
bd.java: Prepared battlefield action; implementations queue events or represent turn-condition markers.
be.java: Recomputes summoning bonus and queues SummonEvent.
bg.java: Intrusive sentinel buckets with key lookup, traversal, insertion and clearing.
bl.java: Loads and caches group-zero quick-chat categories from local/global archives; global IDs use bit 32768. Unrelated static helpers retain separate purposes.
bm.java: Validates archive indexes and group responses from disk caches and the resource protocol client.
bo.java: Five 29-entry arrays store stage positions and spacing; accessors center coordinates on a 640 by 480 reference surface. Static helpers also decode spells.
bp.java: Separate queued/in-flight priority and normal request lanes with twenty-request caps.
bv.java: Extends PacketBuffer with bit cursor and ciphered opcode output.
ca.java: Tagged fields name/mf/ownr/tag/god and MapTile metadata accessors.
cf.java: Named campaign container with mission and participant tables, archive index and local-player label.
ci.java: Tutorial prompts, flashing controls and stage-indexed kr tables.
cj.java: Stores a copied payload in a direct ByteBuffer; reads return a fresh full-capacity byte array.
cl.java: Scores movement/attack choices for one unit, orders unit decisions and executes the selected candidate.
cm.java: Three campaign result tables with 64 mission slots, versioned decoding, result updates and score aggregation.

co.java: Theme ID, terrain/foliage/structure sprite names and arrays, preview colours, background image, ambient samples and music assets. Unrelated static ranking/text helpers retain separate purposes.
cq.java: Shared campaign/mission/quicksave entry with title, bounds, availability, score and preview sprites.
cv.java: Campaign cards, mission-map entries, score updates, selection and quicksave dialogs.
dg.java: Retains the basic sprite archive, loads battle marker/effect sprites and switches shared theme sprite bindings. Unrelated static chat/menu helpers retain separate purposes.
dk.java: Turn preparation creates this for type-10 units on corpse tiles with maximum strength 19; player flag 1024.
dl.java: Shared tutorial/menu selection, keyboard input, pointer press state and repeat countdown; also used outside the tutorial.
dm.java: Tutorial stage-5 match options: player counts, map size, preview choices, item labels and per-item geometry.

dn.java: Retains a supplied content component inside a clipping viewport with a copied vertical scrollbar; clamps pending scroll offsets and consumes button/page/wheel/drag input. Unrelated static helpers retain separate purposes.

dp.java: Single-line mutable text with caret/selection, printable-character filtering, separator navigation, pointer selection and asynchronous clipboard tasks; unrelated static helpers retain separate purposes.
dq.java: Retained symbol lengths, left-aligned code words and decode trie; packs bytes MSB-first and decodes a requested output length. Unrelated static helpers retain separate purposes.
ea.java: Retained first/lobby-or-game, friends and ignore TabbedPanel wrapper and shared social-control layout; unrelated chat/login static helpers retain separate purposes.
ec.java: Diagnostic EventTeleport with source and destination positions.
ee.java: Checks a type-72 Sphinx has an attack remaining, then prepares its delegated action with ownership bypass.
eh.java: Retained submap count, selected submap and floor/residue indices for the client single-channel decode path.
ei.java: RandomAccessFile wrapper with position accounting and a maximum file length.
ej.java: Evaluates own/enemy power, capture and summoning scores against Battlefield.
em.java: Instance counts calls up to a limit and resets; unrelated static methods load client assets and handle client messages.
eo.java: Camera visibility, retained UnitModelPreview objects and per-unit model animation/projection updates.
eu.java: Wraps forward/reverse selection through the player unit deque, refreshing after the selected node is unlinked.
ew.java: Abstract archive-index, encoded-group and group-progress contract.
f.java: CacheEntry retaining its value directly as an Object and reporting no reference-backed representation. Unrelated static fields retain separate purposes.
fg.java: Pooled raster target/dimensions/clip snapshot used by nested save/restore helpers; unrelated quick-chat/reflection helpers retain separate purposes.
fi.java: Owns one unit popup, layout coordinates, fade animation and scrolling unit-name feedback; static helpers also generate terrain.
fp.java: Client component combining selected/unselected icon styles with a measured text label and inherited visual state; unrelated static helpers retain separate purposes.
ft.java: Two integer components used as both positions and dimensions by panel layout helpers; retains its intrusive-node links and unrelated static helpers.
fu.java: Displays the first unlocked unit, a spell or a mana bonus using the existing reward precedence.
g.java: Stores the original throwable in its own field and accumulates a context string; it does not initialize the standard Java cause.
ga.java: 256-word ISAAC state, golden-ratio seed mixing and opcode cipher output.
gb.java: BattleTutorial subclass whose specialist-equipment lesson texts follow Eastbridge; tracks the current equipped slot and eligibility gates.
gd.java: Vertex/face arrays and transformed mesh used by combat characters.
ge.java: Samples candidates using fourth-power normalized score weights.
gh.java: Text/arrow controls, option list, prefix selection and expandable dropdown viewport.
gm.java: Own Win: Leader Escort diagnostic; succeeds when every tracked leader has reached its goal.
go.java: Constructor stores team name and player IDs; membership checks scan those IDs.
gr.java: Piecewise fixed-point amplitude/time segments, waveform type and start/end scalars; mutable reset/step cursor shared by synthesis envelopes.
gs.java: Instance draws a shaded dropdown button and downward arrow; static packet polling and other helpers remain separate.
ha.java: Owns the rectangular tile grid, unit lists, player/team state, mana and turns.
hd.java: Runnable queue servicing platform tasks, including sockets, threads, reflection, clipboard, fullscreen/cursor adapters and retained cache files; constructor side effects remain unchanged.
hh.java: Interpolates an integer pulse over two halves of a TickCounter period, with original byte-range defaults/clamps.
hi.java: Blocking input plus a bounded asynchronous output ring and deferred write errors.

hl.java: Shared friend/ignore-list row with current/previous display names, optional account name, online location label, ordering and lazy name/location/rename components. Unrelated sprite helpers retain separate purposes.
hm.java: Versioned spell quantities, five equipped spell IDs, seven unit-unlock masks, rune accounting and campaign progress.
ho.java: Own diagnostic names turnsTaken and damageTaken; consumed by campaign scoring.
hp.java: Diagnostic EventDeath and battlefield application of unit death.
hr.java: Unit-model selection, yaw, screen position, animation player and projection used by instruction illustrations.
ht.java: Sparse signed-smart transform components, preceding pivot slots and interpolation flags decoded against a shared skeleton.
hu.java: Pitch/amplitude envelopes, five oscillator slots, optional modulation/gating/echo and recursive filtering into shared signed PCM scratch.
hw.java: Checks chosen gods, tile summoning permissions and affordability, then prepares a SummonAction.
i.java: Report-target text, rule/offence choices, optional mute control and close/wait/cancel state; unrelated static helpers retain separate purposes.
ic.java: Owns Battlefield, selected units, movement plans and AI planners; coordinates game input and display.
id.java: Instance data override unit type/name/strength when AiPlanner registers a campaign unit; static helpers also load assets.
ig.java: Decoded transform slots: type, mesh group indices and per-slot masks; frames share this object by identity.
ik.java: Abstract spell ID, payload size/serialization and effect lifecycle; concrete implementations read spellDefinitions.
il.java: Created during turn preparation for displaced units; canonical application has no battlefield mutation.
im.java: Empty instance root for linked client UI components; unrelated static helpers retain separate purposes.
in.java: Canonical Huffman code lengths/decode tree and lookup-type vector tables decoded from shared Vorbis bits.
iq.java: Fixed-height labeled button with centered coordinates, pointer hit testing and drawing.
ir.java: Tile cost propagation and distance-weighted power/influence accumulation.
iu.java: In-battle tutorial stages, messages, action notifications, control highlights and animated hint panel; distinct from the tutorial menu controller.

ja.java: Averaged tile-coordinate cluster consumed by GameplayController camera overviews; proximity grouping, hold-started flag and a forty-call hold counter. Unrelated static helpers retain separate purposes.
jb.java: Movement/attack/spell target coordinates, score and execution result for an AI choice.
jc.java: Checks ownership, movement-spent state, deploy capability and terrain before preparing a DeployAction.
jd.java: Tagged fields c/o/str/max/x/y decode type, owner, strength and coordinates.
je.java: Client UI bounds, retained style/font/sprite/text, linked children, input traversal and rendering contract; distinct from the shared Widget hierarchy.
jf.java: Padded response buffer, received block position and resource completion/progress accessors.
jm.java: Versions 5–7 decode group/file IDs, revisions, CRCs, optional names and 64-byte digests.
jr.java: Unit/god choice identity, icon group, radial offsets and circular hit radius.
js.java: Decoded vertex coordinates, face indices/materials, normal accumulation and animation skin groups used to construct ModelMesh.
k.java: Canonical account lookup keys: trims the four separator characters, enforces a 1–12-character trimmed span, drops unsupported characters and folds the retained alphabet.
ka.java: Glyph metrics, text width, markup parsing and drawing.
kb.java: Base UI node: position, width/height, painter dispatch and pointer hit testing; unrelated static helpers retain separate purposes.
kc.java: Diagnostic EventTurnChange with new turn and active player.
kf.java: Diagnostic EventGrowth with strength and owner information.
kg.java: One normalized x/y/z vector retained for a flat-shaded face.
kh.java: Widget drawing contract invoked with parent-origin offsets, a guard and a rendering flag.
kj.java: Turn preparation creates this when at least 25 type-20 skeletons remain; player flag 8192.
kk.java: Abstract mesh copy, transform, animation and drawing contract implemented by ModelMesh.
kl.java: Lazy archive index, packed group storage, unpacked file storage and named resource lookup.
kn.java: Diagnostic EventTelefrag on the affected unit.
kr.java: Diagnostic EventMove with start position and directional footsteps.
ks.java: Abstract pending/data/progress contract shared by disk and network requests.
lc.java: Two-channel pole-pair filter endpoints and gain interpolation, producing shared float and 16.16 coefficient scratch.
ld.java: Copies path directions, computes attack origin and queues MoveEvent and optional AttackEvent.
lf.java: Own BattleCharacter diagnostic; animated combat character model, current/destination coordinates and animation state.
lh.java: Texture availability, pixel and colour queries used by mesh construction and textured rasterization; unresolved property queries retain their names.
ll.java: Linked up/down buttons, track halves and draggable thumb; proportional geometry, drag conversion and shared held-button repeat counter. Unrelated static helpers retain separate purposes.
ln.java: Six part choices and colour indices, coat query string, layer setters and drawing helpers.
lo.java: Map format version, dimensions, terrain decoding, saved units and tagged map items.
lr.java: Open-addressed integer key table returning original input indices, with linear probing.
lv.java: Victory/defeat predicate and diagnostic-description contract shared by three concrete match conditions.
m.java: Masked-key sentinel buckets accepting intrusive primary nodes and duplicate keys, with independent Iterator traversal. Unrelated static fields retain separate purposes.
mb.java: Diagnostic EventSummon with position, bonus and player.
mc.java: Own Defeat: Total Unit Loss diagnostic; checks allied units and usable portals, with campaign restrictions.
md.java: Diagnostic EventParasite with position, destination and owner.
me.java: Quick-chat command ID and number of unsigned-short arguments retained by phrase definitions; the two other constructor integers are unused. Unrelated static helpers retain separate purposes.
mg.java: Abstract set/get byte contract for the retained direct-buffer implementation; unrelated static helpers retain separate purposes.
ml.java: Linked tab buttons and caller-retained content panels; evenly spaced tab geometry and active-panel switching. Unrelated static helpers retain separate purposes.
mm.java: Callback notified when Battlefield registers a unit; AiPlanner updates its unit-planner list.
mn.java: Abstract preparation contract shared by movement, summoning, deployment, spell casts and Sphinx-assisted actions.

mo.java: Retained chat channel, sender/account/display identity, text/label, filter classification and rendered row; constructors snapshot decoded state or create a system message. Unrelated static helpers retain separate purposes.
mp.java: Scrollable retained social-list content with add/remove buttons, prototype copying and shared bottom-row geometry. Unrelated static helpers retain separate purposes.
mq.java: ClientUiComponent containing shortcut-prefixed item components, phrase IDs, submenus and collapse animation/navigation state; unrelated static helpers retain separate purposes.
ms.java: IntrusiveNode plus independent secondary links and a key that cannot be changed while secondary-linked.
mt.java: Instance owns a string, character position and end test; static helpers also decode short tagged-field names.
ne.java: Tagged fields unit/own/type/mod decode occupant, owner, terrain and metadata.
nf.java: ClientUiComponent composing optional icon and text children, measuring their width and laying them out together; unrelated static helpers retain separate purposes.
nh.java: Disk request operation, store and byte payload with inherited pending state.
ni.java: Empty instance root shared by MeshData and ModelMeshBase; unrelated static helpers retain separate purposes.
nn.java: Grid costs, path state and unit action packet serialization.
np.java: Bounded list of icon/text action rows, measured popup placement and action-ID polling with waiting/cancel sentinels; unrelated static helpers retain separate purposes.
ns.java: Diagnostic EventAttack on the attacking unit.
nw.java: Diagnostic EventDamage with damage amount and poison flag.
oc.java: Anchored account-name prompt with instruction/input components, mutable name buffer and waiting/cancel/submit state; modern polling and legacy key handling remain distinct.
of.java: Account/name and lobby player row with rating/unlocks, invitation/join-request state, notification lifetime and ordering. Unrelated static helpers retain separate purposes.
oj.java: Abstract battlefield application and gameplay presentation of unit events.
om.java: Tagged campaign mission identity, metadata, player slots and lazy map loading.
ou.java: Free/member map archives, retained maps by theme and size, player-capacity selection and tutorial maps. Unrelated static helpers retain separate purposes.
p.java: Retains effect/music archives, decoded PCM samples and unfinished music samples; unrelated static client/text helpers retain separate purposes.
pa.java: Shared initialization, frame advancement, drawing and completion contract for four event presentations.
pe.java: Queues GrowthEvent with destination, origin, strength and acting player.
pj.java: Legacy Trinketused diagnostic; dispatches Spell.applyEffect and battlefield spell-cost handling.
pl.java: Queues DeathEvent for vine type 39 or DeployEvent for supported deployable units.
pp.java: Dropdown option storage, selected/hovered indices, row height and option rendering.
pq.java: Synchronized AWT mouse callbacks maintain live pointer/button state; focus loss clears the held button and popup triggers are consumed. Unrelated static helpers retain separate purposes.
pr.java: Maps image palette indices to regions, retains marker anchors, identifies clicked regions and renders masks.
q.java: Diagnostic EventTelepop on the affected unit.
qb.java: Opcode-decoded packed frame IDs, durations, loop start/count and additional retained sequence data.
qg.java: RGB sprite canvas/pixel bounds and offsets inherited by RgbSprite.
qj.java: Diagnostic EventUpkeep at a unit position.
ql.java: Short-lived overlays for damage, ownership, spell and status feedback.
